property_summary: For any caller address a and target newOwner, only the current owner can change owner via setOwner (i.e., after a call by a, c.owner() == a iff a was the prior owner); the mutant removes the onlyOwner check so a non-owner can become owner — the test fuzzes caller and newOwner and detects when a non-owner successfully changes owner.
change_summary: Delete the require check inside onlyOwner, effectively removing the ownership restriction so anyone may call setOwner.
